newsitem.title: USA: NPS Pharmaceuticals to begin clinical trial.
newsitem.headline: NPS Pharmaceuticals to begin clinical trial.

text.p: NPS Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday that a Phase II clinical trial of its drug candidate for treating hyperparathyroidism, R-568, is expected to begin in the United States by the end of the year.
Phase I trials of the trial should begin shortly in Japan, it said.
The company said the United States trial is to be conducted by Amgen Inc, while the Japanese trials wil be conducted by the pharmaceutical division of Kirin Brewery Co Ltd of Tokyo.
Hyperparathyroidism is an age-related disorder that causes excessive secretion of parathyroid hormone from glands in the neck. The result is high levels of calcium in the blood.
